decisions.notes: Single uncontrolled five-day case with self-reported outcomes, possible placebo and contextual effects, and no generalizability. The Abstract swaps standing and walking follow-up durations relative to the mutually consistent Case Presentation/Results and Fig. 5; preserve this source-internal discrepancy. ECAP represents neural recruitment, not pain intensity.
